## README

# Home Assistant Chromecast Caster (YouTube + SoundCloud)

Cast YouTube videos and SoundCloud tracks to a Google Chromecast from Home Assistant. This repo provides:

- Scripts for YouTube and SoundCloud casting with clear status notifications
- Helpers (text + dropdown) to paste links and choose the target device
- A ready-to-paste Lovelace card
- YAML snippets to include in `configuration.yaml`

Works via:
- YouTube: `media_player.play_media` with the YouTube app
- SoundCloud: `media_extractor.play_media` to resolve the stream

---

## Requirements

- Home Assistant with the Google Cast integration (to discover your Chromecast devices)
- For SoundCloud: enable `media_extractor:` in `configuration.yaml` (see below). `ffmpeg:` is recommended and included in HA OS.

---

## Option 1 — UI-only setup (no file editing)

1) Create Helpers (UI)
- Text helper: Settings → Devices & services → Helpers → Create helper → Text
  - Name: "YouTube URL to Cast"
  - Entity: `input_text.youtube_url_to_cast`
  - Max length: ≤ 255
- Text helper (optional, for SoundCloud): Name: "SoundCloud URL to Cast"
  - Entity: `input_text.soundcloud_url_to_cast`
- Dropdown helper: Create helper → Dropdown
  - Name: "Cast Target"
  - Options: add your Chromecast `media_player.*` entity_ids (e.g., `media_player.living_room_chromecast`)
  - Entity: `input_select.cast_target`

2) Add Scripts (UI)
- Settings → Automations & scenes → Scripts → + Create script → ⋮ → Edit in YAML
- Create these two scripts (paste the body only, no wrapper key at the top):

YouTube script body:
```yaml
alias: Cast YouTube from input
mode: restart
sequence:
  - variables:
      url: "{{ states('input_text.youtube_url_to_cast') | trim }}"
      # Safe extractor: get first 11-char ID from common YouTube URL shapes
      video_id: >-
        {{ (url
            | regex_findall('(?:youtu\\.be/|[?&]v=|/shorts/|/live/|/embed/)([A-Za-z0-9_-]{11})')
            | first
            | default('', true))
           or (url if url|length == 11 else '') }}
      target_entity: "{{ states('input_select.cast_target') }}"
      valid_target: "{{ target_entity is string and target_entity.startswith('media_player.') }}"
      valid_id: "{{ video_id|length == 11 }}"

  - service: persistent_notification.create
    data:
      notification_id: youtube_cast_status
      title: "YouTube Cast: starting…"
      message: >-
        URL: {{ url }}
        Parsed ID: {{ video_id if valid_id else '—' }}
        Target: {{ target_entity if valid_target else '—' }}

  - choose:
      - conditions: "{{ valid_id and valid_target }}"
        sequence:
          - service: media_player.play_media
            target:
              entity_id: "{{ target_entity }}"
            data:
              media_content_type: cast
              media_content_id: >
                {{ {'app_name':'youtube','media_id': video_id} | tojson }}
          - service: persistent_notification.create
            data:
              notification_id: youtube_cast_status
              title: "YouTube Cast: sent ✅"
              message: "Sent {{ video_id }} to {{ state_attr(target_entity, 'friendly_name') or target_entity }}."
          - service: logbook.log
            data:
              name: YouTube Caster
              message: "Casting {{ video_id }} to {{ state_attr(target_entity, 'friendly_name') or target_entity }}"
              entity_id: "{{ target_entity }}"

      - conditions: "{{ not valid_id }}"
        sequence:
          - service: persistent_notification.create
            data:
              notification_id: youtube_cast_status
              title: "YouTube Cast: failed ❌"
              message: >-
                Could not parse a YouTube video ID from:
                {{ url }}
                Tip: paste a normal YouTube link or just the 11-char ID (e.g., dQw4w9WgXcQ).

      - conditions: "{{ not valid_target }}"
        sequence:
          - service: persistent_notification.create
            data:
              notifica

concept.one_liner: Cast YouTube videos and SoundCloud tracks to Chromecast using Home Assistant.
concept.core_promise: Effortlessly stream YouTube and SoundCloud media to your Chromecast devices through Home Assistant.

buyers.pain: They want to integrate media streaming into their Home Assistant setup but struggle with complex configurations.

buyers.persona: tech-savvy smart home users who are familiar with Home Assistant but not yet using media features
buyers.pain: They find it difficult to stream media easily through their existing smart home setup.
candidate_phrases: how to stream youtube on smart home

judged.rationale: The interest in smart home automation is growing, and those users likely seek solutions to integrate media streaming. Buyers are proactive but not desperate, hence moderate urgency. The MVP involves some technical setup but builds on existing Home Assistant infrastructure, so it's moderately easy to create. Distribution via forums and communities is feasible but not trivial, given the niche audience. Retention is moderately high due to ongoing use of Home Assistant. No clear advantage is indicated in the idea, so competitiveness will rely on implementation quality.

offers_and_verdict.next_action: Engage with 3-5 online smart home automation communities and forums to validate interest and pain points in media streaming integration. Gather qualitative insights from discussions or small surveys.
offers_and_verdict.reasoning: The overall search demand for this idea is low, indicating limited organic traffic. While the buyer urgency is moderate, signalling some intent to solve this problem, the willingness to pay is low because the niche is highly DIY-oriented and technical. MVP ease and distribution fit scores suggest that it’s feasible to build and distribute in communities. However, the lack of competitive advantage and retention potential poses significant growth risks. Therefore, further engagement with relevant communities is advisable to refine the problem-solution fit and understand where users truly struggle with media integration.
